analysis.title: Dark Tumbler Product Landing Page
analysis.notes: A restrained dark landing-page composition centers a matte black tumbler against oversized, low-contrast background lettering and a vivid orange circular accent. Cream display typography, small utility labels, and translucent information panels create a polished editorial product-study feel.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a moody editorial product hero featuring a matte-black insulated tumbler with a lid and straw, standing slightly right of center against a deep charcoal background. Add a large, partially obscured orange-red outlined circle behind the product, subtle oversized tonal lettering in the background, and soft directional lighting that reveals the tumbler’s curved silhouette. Use restrained cream typography-like blocks and faint translucent interface panels around the composition, with no legible words, logos, or branding. High contrast, minimal grid-based art direction, cinematic shadows, premium product photography.
